tools.name: access_compute
tools.description: Compute access intervals between two objects over the scenario interval.

tools.name: access_batch
tools.description: Compute access from one source object to several target objects.

tools.name: access_report
tools.description: Generate an STK access report (Access style) between two objects.

tools.name: access_set_constraint
tools.description: Set a minimum/maximum access constraint (for example ElevationAngle) on an object.

tools.name: access_clear_constraints
tools.description: Remove all access constraints from an object.

tools.name: data_provider_list
tools.description: List data providers and their groups for an object.

tools.name: data_provider_query
tools.description: Execute a data-provider query and return a table of results. Use a single time for an instant query or start/stop/step for a time series.

provider.description: Data provider name, e.g. Cartesian Position

tools.name: lighting_compute
tools.description: Compute sunlight/eclipse intervals for an object.

tools.name: report_list_styles
tools.description: List available STK report styles (*.rst) from the installed STKData and the user's Config\Styles directories. Use a returned name as report_create.style.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. Access or Satellite

tools.name: report_create
tools.description: Generate an STK report through ReportCreate and return the file path plus preview.

style.description: STK report style, e.g. 'Access' or 'LLA Position'

tools.name: animation_control
tools.description: Control scenario animation: play, pause, stop, step, set_time or set_rate.

epoch_seconds.description: Seconds from scenario start for set_time

tools.name: animation_info
tools.description: Read the current animation time, scenario time bounds and playback rate.

tools.name: scenario_set_view
tools.description: Activate the 2D/3D graphics windows and optionally show all objects.

tools.name: stk_connect
tools.description: Launch or attach to STK 11/12 through COM. Existing instances are reused; a new instance is started only when no STK automation object is running.

prog_id.description: STK ProgID. Omit to use auto-detection (STK 11 preferred, then STK 12).

visible.description: Show the STK desktop window (headed mode)

user_control.description: Allow the user to interact with STK

force.description: Reconnect even if a session is already active

tools.name: stk_disconnect
tools.description: Release the STK COM reference. Do NOT call this at the end of a modeling or analysis task: leave the scenario open for the user. The STK process is not quit and the scenario is not closed by default.

tools.name: stk_status
tools.description: Report whether the kernel is connected, the STK version/PID and the open scenario.

tools.name: stk_capabilities
tools.description: List the STK version, object types supported by the installed license, and the available Connect port. Useful before building a workflow.

tools.name: stk_execute_command
tools.description: Execute a raw STK Connect command. transport=com uses the COM ExecuteCommand path; transport=tcp uses the Connect socket and returns raw reply data.

tools.name: stk_selftest
tools.description: Run an end-to-end STK smoke test: scenario, satellite orbit, propagation, state query, facility, access, coverage and report. With an existing scenario open it performs read-only checks unless replace_scenario=true.

replace_scenario.description: Close the current scenario and run the full write test

tools.name: coverage_create
tools.description: Create a coverage definition.

tools.name: coverage_set_grid
tools.description: Set a global or latitude/longitude coverage grid.

tools.name: coverage_add_asset
tools.description: Assign an object as a coverage asset.

tools.name: coverage_remove_asset
tools.description: Remove an asset from a coverage definition.

tools.name: coverage_compute
tools.description: Compute coverage accesses and return high-level coverage statistics.

tools.name: coverage_stats
tools.description: Read coverage statistics without recomputing accesses.

tools.name: coverage_fom_create
tools.description: Create a Figure of Merit under a coverage definition and optionally set its type.

definition_type.description: STK FOM definition type index (0 = default Coverage)

tools.name: coverage_fom_query
tools.description: Query a figure-of-merit data provider.

tools.name: coverage_grid_inspector
tools.description: Select a grid point and read its point/region coverage values.

tools.name: equipment_create
tools.description: Create an antenna, receiver, transmitter or radar on a parent object.

model.description: Optional STK model name, e.g. 'Simple Transmitter Model'

replace_existing.description: Unload an existing equipment with this name

tools.name: equipment_list
tools.description: List antennas, receivers, transmitters and radars on a parent object.

tools.name: equipment_delete
tools.description: Delete an antenna/receiver/transmitter/radar from its parent.

tools.name: equipment_configure
tools.description: Configure a transmitter (frequency/EIRP/data rate), antenna (design frequency/diameter) or receiver (G/T). Only writable model properties are applied; unsupported fields are returned in errors.

tools.name: object_list
tools.description: List objects in the scenario, optionally filtered by class and including nested children such as sensors and equipment.

class_name.description: Filter by ClassName, e.g. Satellite, Facility, Sensor, CoverageDefinition

tools.name: object_info
tools.description: Return detailed metadata for one object and optionally its children.

tools.name: object_delete
tools.description: Unload an object from the scenario.

tools.name: facility_create
tools.description: Create a ground facility at a geodetic position.

replace_existing.description: Unload an existing facility with this name

tools.name: facility_set_position
tools.description: Move an existing facility.

tools.name: place_create
tools.description: Create a point place at a geodetic position.

replace_existing.description: Unload an existing place with this name

tools.name: place_set_position
tools.description: Move an existing point place.

tools.name: area_target_create
tools.description: Create a ground area target, optionally as an ellipse.

tools.name: area_target_set_ellipse
tools.description: Configure an existing area target as an ellipse.

tools.name: area_target_set_polygon
tools.description: Configure an existing area target as a polygon boundary from lat/lon points.

tools.name: area_target_add_boundary_point
tools.description: Append one boundary point to an area target (switches it to polygon mode).

tools.name: target_set_position
tools.description: Set a target position from geodetic coordinates or spherical (declination, right ascension, altitude).

tools.name: target_create
tools.description: Create a celestial target object (star-like pointing target).

tools.name: sensor_create
tools.description: Create a sensor on a parent object and configure a simple cone.

tools.name: sensor_set_cone
tools.description: Set the half-angle of a SimpleCone sensor.

tools.name: sensor_list
tools.description: List sensors, optionally limited to one parent object.

tools.name: constellation_create
tools.description: Create a constellation and optionally add satellites to it.

tools.name: constellation_add_object
tools.description: Add a satellite/object to a constellation.

tools.name: constellation_list
tools.description: List constellations and their members.

tools.name: constellation_build_walker
tools.description: Batch-build a Walker Delta/Star constellation from circular orbits and add all generated satellites to a constellation object.

pattern.description: Walker pattern: delta (360° RAAN spread) or star (180°)

mean_anomaly0_deg.description: Mean anomaly of the first satellite (deg)

replace_existing.description: Unload an existing constellation with this name

tools.name: chain_create
tools.description: Create an access chain and optionally add objects to it.

tools.name: chain_add_object
tools.description: Append an object to an access chain.

tools.name: chain_compute_access
tools.description: Compute access through a chain and return the computed strand intervals.

tools.name: platform_create
tools.description: Create an aircraft, ship or ground vehicle.

tools.name: platform_list
tools.description: List aircraft, ships and ground vehicles in the scenario.

tools.name: platform_set_waypoints
tools.description: Set a time-specified great-arc route for an aircraft, ship or ground vehicle and propagate it.

tools.name: platform_state
tools.description: Query an aircraft/ship/ground-vehicle position at a time.

tools.name: object_set_graphics
tools.description: Set 2D graphics attributes such as visibility, label, marker and line style.

tools.name: object_get_graphics
tools.description: Read the main 2D graphics attributes of an object.

tools.name: satellite_create
tools.description: Create a satellite in the current scenario and select a propagator.

replace_existing.description: Unload an existing satellite with the same name

tools.name: satellite_set_orbit
tools.description: Define a satellite orbit from classical elements, a Cartesian state, TLE lines, or an ephemeris file, then propagate it.

raan_deg.description: Classical: right ascension of ascending node (deg)

tools.name: satellite_propagate
tools.description: Propagate the satellite ephemeris to the scenario time interval.

tools.name: satellite_state
tools.description: Query a satellite's Cartesian position/velocity, LLA and classical elements at a specific time or at the scenario start.

tools.name: satellite_tle_summary
tools.description: Read the TLE summary data provider for a satellite (epoch, elements, validity).

tools.name: satellite_ephemeris
tools.description: Sample a satellite ephemeris over an interval and optionally write a CSV file.

tools.name: astrogator_summary
tools.description: List the Astrogator main-sequence segments for a satellite.

tools.name: astrogator_run
tools.description: Run the Astrogator main sequence (RunMCS) and return the resulting state.

tools.name: satellite_set_propagator
tools.description: Change the propagator of an existing satellite (TwoBody, J2, J4, HPOP, SGP4).

tools.name: satellite_list
tools.description: List satellites in the current scenario.

tools.name: scenario_create
tools.description: Create a new STK scenario. Closes the open scenario only when replace_existing=true; otherwise it fails rather than silently discarding work.

start_time.description: Start epoch (ISO-8601 or STK UTCG). Defaults to the current UTC minute.

duration_hours.description: Duration used when stop_time is omitted

path.description: Optional .sc path. Saving requires confirm_save=true and an ASCII-only path.

confirm_save.description: Explicit user approval to save; never set true without asking the user

tools.name: scenario_open
tools.description: Open an existing .sc scenario file.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a .sc file

tools.name: scenario_save
tools.description: Save the current scenario in place or to a new .sc path. Requires explicit confirm_save=true; without a path it uses STK's default scenario location. Paths must be ASCII-only (no Chinese characters).

path.description: Save-as path; omit to save in STK's default location

confirm_save.description: Explicit user approval to save; never set true without asking the user

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing save-as file

tools.name: scenario_close
tools.description: Close the current scenario without quitting STK.

tools.name: scenario_info
tools.description: Return the current scenario name, time period, duration and top-level objects.

tools.name: scenario_set_time
tools.description: Update the scenario start/stop time (or extend by duration_hours).

duration_hours.description: Duration from start when stop is omitted
